mappings.subject: Grounded Answer
mappings.rule: CKA projects the KAP grounded answer; it does not create a second answer runtime.

mappings.subject: Knowledge Retrieval
mappings.rule: CKA retrieval must use governed knowledge authorities and may not answer from LLM memory alone.

mappings.subject: Published Knowledge
mappings.rule: Published PHI OS knowledge is an active grounding authority for production Ask.

mappings.subject: Related Knowledge
mappings.rule: Related Knowledge cards are authority-backed and may not be invented by the client.

mappings.subject: Book
mappings.rule: Book pages may hand off book context to Ask PHI OS without transferring Book authority to CKA.

mappings.subject: Article
mappings.rule: Article pages may hand off article context to Ask PHI OS without changing publication authority.

mappings.subject: Figure
mappings.rule: Current Figure detail is CKA-enabled; a future figure class may be NONE_BY_DESIGN only when explicitly registered.

mappings.subject: Reality Runtime
mappings.rule: CKA may consume authorized current Reality context but may not silently create or mutate canonical Reality.

mappings.subject: Account
mappings.rule: History and save are account-only; Guest Ask remains non-persistent.

mappings.subject: Journey
mappings.rule: Simple questions remain answers; Journey is only a governed complex-case escalation.

mappings.subject: Method Runtime
mappings.rule: Ask PHI OS never directly executes Method Runtime; eligible users hand off to the governed Personal Runtime / MPA path.
